name: Hawk Dash
summary: Hawk Dash, second likeness pass: the front and rear now have sloped shoulders and tucked door sections, broader framed headlamps, angled LED recesses and a lower intake that widens towards the bottom. The rear has framed red/grey lamps, a boot seam, a wider wing, and a six-sided exhaust recess with painted lip, black bevel and larger hexagonal outlets. The low-cost wheels remain. Triangle totals are 2697 / 837 / 553, within the existing 2800 / 900 / 600 budgets. Collision hulls and handling are retained. The enlarged front/rear comparisons lead each sheet below; the owner judges the likeness.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

findings.text: source / contract / reproducibility: bake.txt, reproducibility.txt, contract.txt. GLBs reproduced byte-for-byte; sidecar and profile validate without waivers.

geometry / budgets: geometry.json and verify.mjs inspect shipped GLBs: 2697 / 837 / 553 triangles versus 2800 / 900 / 600. All eleven damage part IDs, one material, finite vertices/normals and nonzero triangles. Wheels cost 176 / 112 / 112; sealed inner sidewalls, manifold edges and ground contact retained. Previous pass totals were 2689 / 883 / 597.

visual cue revision: stronger sill and shoulder taper at every tier; door seams follow the skin; front intake widens downward; broader outlined headlamps and angled vertical LED recesses. Rear gains red/grey framed lamps, boot seam, full-width wing and shaped six-sided exhaust surround with painted lip, dark bevel, central fins and larger hexagonal tips. Actual rear-cap triangles now match the decal projection, fixing broken stripes on nonplanar polygons. Closed diffuser, fins and wing tips retained. Coarse tiers use continuous flat fascia graphics; their stripes sit behind grille/intake/lamp layers, avoiding broken lamps and floating stripe fragments. Fascia ray projection is restricted to its own front/back part so a missing rear hit cannot paint onto a door or front fender and corrupt the hinge bounds.

silhouette tradeoff: weighted IoU .9495 / .9472 / .9362 versus first-pass .9652 / .9612 / .9490. Top-view widening is the largest regression. Reference sheets and cameras are unchanged, and this candidate is not claimed to improve every outline. Enlarged front/rear rows and the previous/revised/diff sheets expose the tradeoff for owner review. Exact per-view scores are in reference-lodN/score.json. LOD2 falls below the method's approximate .95 target; the owner likeness verdict is pending.

paint / hinges / identity contract: focused pivots, paint-key and spec-twin tests in paint-spec-tests.txt; one shared atlas material, neutral wheels/lamps and seat paint retained. Paint strips and LOD sheets reviewed. Existing roof-number mount retained above the unchanged crown. Small-grid evidence is a viewer sample, not proof of runtime number readability or an N×N host benchmark.

damage geometry: damage-strip.png and damage-strip-overview.png show intact, loose, detached and stripped states with dark bays using existing evidence tooling. This does not retest dynamic debris lifetime; damage runtime code is unchanged.

physics fit: sim.json runs the focused settle fixture and existing Hawk straight-run fixture through native jj-sim; both pass and replay matches. Collision hulls and handling are unchanged; no driving-feel claim.

POC loading and controls: review-probe.mjs exercises all LODs, bright paint and intact/loose/detached through the actual review page in Chromium and WebKit. Local and deployed results are recorded in self-review.md.

unchanged engine lab: previous pass recorded seven unrelated broad sound-lab failures in P1-V-hawk-curves/engine.txt, tracked by br-8h3u.12. The profile passed schema validation then. Audio has not changed and the broad sound gate is not recertified here.
